label: rem:pawlowski-leitner-basis-construction
title: PBW derivation of the Pawlowski--Leitner basis
html: The construction relies on the PBW theorem over commutative rings: the unital Gröbner--Shirshov basis for U(\mathfrak{su}(2)) provides a monomial basis for the enveloping algebra, from which the intertwiner basis is derived by contraction with the volume form (the diagram of prop:pawlowski-leitner-basis).
heading: Remark
